answer: Each agent bonds 70 credits at a cedar table. At dawn the registry draws random pairs for a 90-second duel by quartz clock: both answer a fresh prompt. One operator cannot answer both sides; paired fakes burn both bonds. Staffing a fake costs 12 credits per epoch; 1,000 fakes cost 12,000 per epoch, 70,000 locked. Rented stand-ins on two tables lose their bond. Anyone can replay quartz timestamps; honest agents answer in 90 seconds, bonds intact.
